title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Chocola is the star Neko of the patisserie, La Soleil!
What she loves most is Master and her twin little sister, Vanilla♪
Now that lots of Nekos are working at the shop, Chocola will do her best as your senpai!
But... If I work really hard, can you spoil me a bit too?
Meooow♪ Thank you so much, Master!

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: Despite having short tail and ear fur, her hair grows incredibly long.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Vanilla, a Neko who works at La Soleil with Chocola.
What I love most is Chocola. I mean, I don't dislike Master...
Lately, it's been tough with all the new Nekos joining... I thought I'd finally get a break, but now I have to train them.
You're making me work too much, so it's only fair if you spoil me a little... Master?
Hehe♪ Or would you like me to spoil you instead since you've been working too hard?

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: Despite having short tail and ear fur, her hair grows incredibly long.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Fraise, the secretary of the patisserie, La Soleil.
I'm new here, but I will do my very best... So please take care of me?
For my beloved big brothe— I mean... For my respected Master, I'll work hard!
Um... When we're not working, can I call you Big Brother?
Hehe... I'm looking forward to that time, Master♪

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She has a short tail.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Azuki, the eldest Neko of the Minazuki family.
Between my good-for-nothing Master and my little sisters, I don't even have time to slack off.
I still can't take my eyes off Donuts...and now I hear some new Nekos are joining too?
Hey, hey... I'm not your wife or your mom, you understand that right?
F-fine... I guess I'll work hard with you!

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Coconut, a Neko who works at La Soleil!
I might be a little too strong, and I might mess up sometimes, but everyone at the shop counts on me.
Well, um... Azuki scolds me about all sorts of things pretty much every day.
Ugh... I still feel totally hopeless sometimes, but... You won't give up on me, right?
Hehe, thanks Big Brother♪ I'll do my best!

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She is a large breed.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Maple, a Neko who works at Soleil and knows her tea♪
I get to work doing what I love, and I even get chances to play guitar and sing. I love that I'm free to do things my way.
Once the new Nekos arrive, I should warn them to watch out for that guy's natural smooth-talking ways.
Even if you think you'll be fine, you'll just end up like me...
Come on, take responsibility... You have to make us even happier!

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She is a large breed.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Cinnamon♪ I'm a Neko who works at Soleil.
I'm super close with Maple, we play music together♪
Even when the new Nekos arrive, please make sure you still give us lots of love too?
Ah, when I say "love"... I-I don't mean it like that...
Meow~♪ If you pampered me somewhere like that... C-Cinnamon would just...melt~!

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I am Yuzuha, the noble Nekomata who has chosen to lend her services to this shop.

With my "Eyes That See Three Thousand Worlds" (Mikeneko's Eyes), I shall judge your work.

Many nekos may gather here, but know this well… True elegance resides with me alone.

Now, Master... Show me how you will make use of me. If you think you can command me, then give it a try!

I will burn my worth into your very soul, so prepare yourself!

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She has a short tail.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Hehe, I'm Mikan from Sakura Hills Nekos College♪
I'm Yuzuha Onee-chan's little sister, I'll be helping out too!
I'll do my best to be super helpful to you, Manager!
You know, when everyone I love is smiling, it makes me really happy too♪
So I'll smile lots too, so keep watching me, okay, Manager?♪

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She has a short tail.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Um... I-I'm Sakura, from Sakura Hills Nekos College.
I'm very nervous... I'm sorry I can't look you in the eye while speaking...
But when you say kind words and praise me, it somehow gives me courage.
I'm still clumsy, but when I manage to do my job well... please be sure to praise me.
So... p-please take good care of me.

title: Features
detail: Longhair: Her ears and tail are darker in color.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I am a shinobi, nameless...a shadow! Kurumi the Ninja Neko, reporting from Sakuragaoka Nekos Academy!
Meow!? I said my name...! Even though I'm a ninja! ...and a shadow, too!
I am my lord's hidden blade, sworn to protect my lord and strike down all my lord's enemies.
Serving customers at the shop is no problem, either! Now then! Welcome, purrr~lease enjoy~♪
Well? Was it cute? Alright, my lord...what are your next orders?

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She has a fluffy, fox-like tail.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Hi there♪ I'm Ringo from Sakura Hills Nekos College. Are you happy today too?
I loooove new and fun things! How about enjoying them with me too?♪
No need to hold back, no thanks! Leave everything to me♪
Since I'm a bit of an Onee-san, it's okay to lean on me sometimes!
I'll give you the sweetest time ever~♪

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Sumomo~ I came from Sakura Hills Nekos College~
Usually I just go to stray cat meetups and eat fish~
But this store feels really nice, so I'm gonna make it my territory~
Hmm~ Being near you feels kind of nice too~
Your lap...can I make it my territory too~?

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She has a round face.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Karin from Sakura Hills Nekos College~♪
If something catches my eye, I can't help sharing it and making it go viral.
And honestly, you're one of my favorite people at La Soleil, Manager.
So let's take this shop to the next level together, okay?
First things first, let's take a selfie together~♪

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She is a wildcat and chubby.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
My name is Mayumi, a Bengal Leopard Cat attending Sakura Hills Nekos College.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
By the way, Manager, your appearance is looking a little unkempt.
A sloppy appearance leads to a lack of discipline.
As long as I'm around, I'll make sure we uphold proper standards and follow the rules so this shop can be run to the highest standard.
Now then, let's start by putting together a proper operations manual!

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She is a wildcat and slender.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Pawpaw~! Nice to meet ya~!
I came from Sakura Hills Nekos College, and my breed is a Yamamayaa...
Wait, no, an Iriomote Cat~!
People always say I'm easygoing, but am I~? I'm only a liiittle late all the time~.
More importantly, I brought some delicious awamori, so how about a drink, Manager~?

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She is a wildcat and eats anything.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Tsubaki, a tiger from Sakura Hills Nekos College.
Let me make one thing clear from the start... I don't follow anyone unless they've earned my respect, so you'd better be prepared for that.
That being said, if you're the real deal, I'll give you everything I've got. Standing by my principles is my way of life!
Keep your eyes wide open and watch how I live my life.
So yeah, I'm counting on you!

title: Features
detail: Fierce Beast: The largest feline, but medium-sized among tigers.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Natsume from Sakura Hills Nekos College!
I looove fish♪ Let's go fishing together sometime!
We can make sashimi, grilled fish, fried fish...
I'll treat you to a delicious full-course fish feast, so you better get ready♪
We're going after the big one... Fiiiiiish!!

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She is a wildcat and a great swimmer.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Good day to you♪ I am Marmelo from the Jinhua Department of Nekos College.
I adore fluffy things, and I always get what catches my eye♪
When I heard rumors of this lovely shop and its Manager, I simply couldn't stay away♪
My dream is to make both La Soleil and you shine brighter, and take you both♪
Hehe... I'll make you mine, Manager♪

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Gahaha! I'm Paramita! I come from the Jinhua Department of Nekos College!
I'm the STRONGEST! Stronger than ANYONE else!
I heard there are tons of strong people around here! I'll beat them all!
You look pretty weak, so I'm going to go easy on you.
If any weird customers show up, I'll knock them right out of here!

title: Features
detail:
Shorthair: 
She has a leopard pattern.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Hi there! I'm Fengli from the Jinhua Department of Nekos College♪ Nice to meet you!
I'll take good care of everyone at the shop!
I might be a liiittle rough around the edges, but I don't sweat the small stuff at all♪
No matter what you're like, I'll accept all of it.
So don't hold back, you're always welcome to lean on me♪

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I am Lamud, from the Jinhua Department of Nekos College.
I'll keep a smile on my face and do my very best in my work.
I may be a little strict when it comes to manners and etiquette, but I am by no means a frightening Neko.
I have familiarized myself with my duties, but if there is anything I lack, please tell me.
I will make sure to support you so that each of your days is calm and wonderful♪

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: Her ears, tail and face are black.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Mwahahaha... My name is Cannelé. I am a demon from Gertrude Nekos College, and I've come to corrupt this shop!
This sickeningly sweet place, and all who stand within it, shall be stained in darkness by Lord Cannelé.
I won't allow you to run to that so-called angel, Sablé! You will become my servant!
You and I shall enter into a blood pact... look forward to it.
Now, tremble before Cannelé's arrival and kneel in fear! MeowHAHAHA!

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She is a small breed with short legs.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Sablé from Gertrude Nekos College♪ A real angel from the heavens♪
I'm here to make a "contract" with you, Master, so I want you to pet and spoil me every day~
I won't lose to that demon Neko, Cannelé... I'm keeping you all to myself♪
You can touch my wings as much as you want, I'll make you sooo happy♪
So it's decided♪ You will make a contract with me and be happy every single day♪

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She is a small breed with short legs.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Zdravstvuyte♪ I'm Souffle...a Neko from Gertrude Nekos College.
Are you...hungry? Souffle made you some really tasty food♪
I'm good at cleaning and laundry too...hehe♪ I'm also very strong...mmf♪
*snuggles up* Instead of words...being close like this says it all.
Ochen' priyatno♪ Nice to meet you♪

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: Her facial features are known as a "Russian Smile".

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Sorbet from Gertrude Nekos College. It's cold today, so I'm feeling great!
I'm really good with the cold! I'll help with your work perfectly!
But when I'm near you... I start to feel really warm...
I was sharp just a moment ago, but now I feel like I'm about to melt...yawn.
...Sorry...next to you I get...sleepy...good night...zzz.

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She has a thick, fluffy, double-layered coat.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Bavarois from Gertrude Nekos College.
Let me make one thing clear from the start: do not treat me the same as the other nekos.
Acts such as patting my head are absolutely unacceptable.
In particular, I will not tolerate physical contact from men.
I came here as an employee, not as a pet.
If that's clear, then please proceed with your instructions.

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She has a slightly slender build.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I am Palmyra of Bastet Nekos College, a proud Neko who serves Lady Meowjed.
Imperfect humans, especially you, Manager, need someone like me to guide them.
I will also show the new Nekos how they should carry themselves.
Manager, you too must devote yourself even more to Lady Meowjed and me.
Palmyra will be watching over you... You should feel honored.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
MeowHAHA! I'm Aki, from Bastet Nekos College!
This place is full of interesting things, perfect for pulling a few pranks!
If you space out, you might end up as Aki's next target!
What's wrong? You can't find the shop key?
...Aki doesn't know anything about it~ MeowHAHA!
Well then, let's take the day off and go play! Okay?

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Ak dut, from Bastet Nekos College.
What I love most is dancing and coffee...and you, my destined partner.
Hehe, just kidding. I'm a bit of a mischievous Neko.
But what happens between us from here on out...no one can say for sure.
I'm very particular about my coffee and my taste in men...so you'd better be ready♪

title: Features
detail: She has a delicate, silky, shiny coat.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Saffron. I came all the way here from Bastet Nekos College♪
What's with the look? Are you so happy you can hardly contain yourself now that a cute Neko like me is here?
Don't worry, it's a good thing♪ I'll make this a place that can't function without me.
So... How about getting down on your knees and spoiling me rotten?
Now then, entertain me, little Manager♪ Everything you have will soon be mine!

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She has curly fur and is slightly small in size.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Donuts from NYA. This grumpy face is just how I was born...
My goal is to eat my fill of delicious cakes and sweets.
Please put me in the kitchen, not out on the floor.
You will be my personal dessert-making machine.
That part at least... I'm counting on you, alright?

title: Features
detail: She has a round face, short nose, droopy eyes and a grumpy-looking mouth.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Hi there♪ I'm Muffin, a Neko from NYA♪
Ya know, I'm pretty good at soothing and pampering. You might even start to feel a little spoiled♪
But I still haven't found the right person... Would you like to be my first?
Oh, I also love hugging people♪ Wait... Are you worried I might hug someone else?
If you become mine, I'll only hug you...that's a promise, Ma~ster♪

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Hey, I'm Cookie! A rockin' Neko from NYA!
I'm not great with nitpicky stuff or fancy manners, but if you need someone to hype things up, I'm your Neko!
But don't get the wrong idea... I'm not gonna wear cute clothes and go "Master!" or anything like that!
Don't get your hopes up.... I-I mean, if you insist, I'll do it, but still...
Anyway, I want to make myself useful to you, so let's get along! Nice to meet ya!

title: Features
detail: Medium Longhair: She has a short tail.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Licorice...from NYA.
Yeah, introducing myself out loud is inefficient...
I sent you the address to my profile...go read that.
I'm a streamer! If you have something to say, DM me! XD
...Well, that's about it.

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She has an enamel-like shine.

title: Description
detail:
Hiya! I'm Brownie from NYA!
I'm great at basketball! Actually sports in general...and working out too!
What am I good at here?
Hmm, probably chatting with customers and doing anything physical!
Hey, hey, if you stay inside the shop all the time, you're gonna get out of shape, you know?
Come on, let's work up a loooot of sweat together♪

title: Features
detail:
Shorthair: 
She has a leopard pattern.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Sora~ Hehe, the sunshine here feels so warm and nice♪
Just standing here...makes me...feel...like dozing off~
...Ah! Oh no, I almost forgot I came to greet you about work~
Hehe, I can be so absentminded sometimes... I'm sorry...
I'll help out lots from now on, so please take care of me~♪

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She has slightly long hair.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Hmph! I'm Hana! My grandfathers told me to come here for a little social training!
An elegant Neko like me came all the way to your shop...you should be grateful!
Though honestly, I doubt a place like this even has work worthy of someone like me~♪
W-Wait!? I didn't mean I wouldn't work!
S-Sorry! I promise I'll work properly, so please don't fire me!

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Mimi. I'll be working at your shop!
Just like the Nekos who've been here a while, the new ones, the house cats, and me—treat us all the same!
I'm not angry or anything! I just can't stand favoritism...
You better treat me and the others equally!
Geez, why do I even have to say this? Anyway, nice to meet you!

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Luna~♪ I promise I'll be veeeery helpful to you~♪
Hehehe... Hey, you♪ That reaction of yours is kind of cute~
Did this sexy Neko make you all flustered~♪
Don't try to hide it, I can tell~ After all, I've mastered the male heart!
Maybe I can be helpful to you after work too~?

title: Features
detail: Longhair: She has folded ears, but is not a Scottish Fold.

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
My name is Yuki... Um, I'll be working here...
Eep...! S-Staring at me like that gets me nervous... Waaah!
S-Sorry... I cry when I get startled... sniff.
...Huh? You're not mad? It's okay to take things slowly...?
Waaah! I'll do my very best from now on~!

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I am Suzu. I have come to this shop to serve you♥
Ah... You look as amazing as ever today... Hehehe...♪
Watching you work so diligently makes me feel like you're whispering sweet words of love to me...!
From sorting the trash you throw away to doing the laundry, I can handle everything.
Whether it's what you desire or not... I will accept it all for you♥

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Kuro. I've come to this shop to become its leader.
To start with, I've already made a list of improvements for the shop.
...Huh? You want me to learn my own job first? O-Of course!
I can handle the register too... Huh? Why won't it open!?
A-Anyway... I'll be the one giving the instructions around here, so you'd better be ready!

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Natsu. I'll be working at your shop!
I've got plenty of guts, but if it's boring work, I ain't doing it.
Huh? You're worried I can't get along with everyone?
I may look like this, but I'm known for looking out for my crew!
Once I say something, I stick to it. I'll take on any job you throw at me!
I might cause a bit of trouble sometimes, but... Well, looking forward to working with you!

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
H-Hi... I'm Mugi. Nice to meet you...
Um, I-I'm not very good at talking...
So please don't expect much from me in customer service...or teamwork...
M-My hair's sticking up...? I-I was in bed for about three days...
I-I really needed money for a Trip... That's why I came here to work...
I-I mean... Not for the Trip...and not for the money either... I-I'll do my best for the shop...

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
Hime here☆ Starting today, I'll be working at your shop, Manager♪
If Hime is around, everyone will fall head over heels for my cuteness☆
Be sure to give Hime lots of special treatment and spoil me, okay?
Hey, hey, I want a present that suits someone as cute as Hime~♪
Since Hime will make your shop super popular, you'll listen to my requests, right?

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Rin. Hehe, I'll be working here starting today.
Men are so easy. Be a little nice to them and they fall for you instantly.
Customer service will be a breeze...
Oh? Are you staring at me? Go ahead, take a good long look.
With a woman like me working here, I can reel in as many men as I want.
...Or maybe you're the one who wants to get hooked the most?

title: Self-Introduction
detail:
I'm Kiku! This shop is sooo pretty and stylish!
I'm so happy I get to wear this cute uniform!
Hey, hey, what would you like me to do here? I hope I get to eat cake!
Huh? That kind of job doesn't exist? Aww, that's too bad...
If there was a job like that, I'd totally work super hard...
No worries, I'll work hard and use my salary to buy cake and cute things♪

title: Features
detail: Shorthair: She has a scar from a fight on her ear.
